title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcer backoff/hysteresis to prevent regional failover thrashing
author: Ethan Carter
description: Context: We've observed a recent incident where the SLO-enforcer's regional failover path repeatedly flipped between regions under bursty traffic (thrashing), which caused unnecessary load on cross-region links and increased tail latency for a subset of customers. Root cause: the enforcer backoff/hysteresis timers were not applied to the legacy priority-queue path in the regional decision codepath. Specifically, when a node reported transient degradation, the new regional-failover decision was applied but the backoff state machine wasn't updated for requests routed through the legacy client compatibility layer, so subsequent heartbeats retriggered failovers rapidly. This PR: 1) Ensures the SLO enforcer updates the shared backoff/hysteresis state for all decision paths (priority-queue, legacy-compat, and dedicated-capacity) so that a single degraded signal triggers the same cooldown across routes. 2) Introduces a small randomized jitter (10-30%) to the base backoff to avoid synchronized retries from multiple regions. 3) Adds a safety cap: if a region has failed over more than 3 times within 10 minutes we extend the backoff multiplier to avoid thrashing. 4) Adds unit tests covering the legacy compatibility path and an integration test that simulates bursty degradation across two regions. 5) Adds observability: new metric slo_enforcer.backoff_applied{path=} and an event emission when the thrash-cap triggers. Implementation notes: - The change is limited to svc/slo-enforcer (decision engine) and svc/slo-agent (heartbeat propagation). - Backwards-compatible: the cooldown parameters are configurable via deployment flags and default to previous behavior except where the missing state updates caused the bug. - No changes to client-facing APIs. Regression/hotfix rationale: this is a reliability hotfix for production incidents (SRE-89). The change is designed to be low-risk and reversible; config knobs allow immediate rollback to previous behavior. Testing: - Local unit tests: added tests for shared backoff state transitions (slo-enforcer/tests/backoff_test.go). - Integration: added a simple two-region simulate test that asserts no more than one failover within 30s for transient spikes. - CI: ran full infra/unit/integration suite. Monitoring & rollout: - Added metrics and an alert rule tweak (sre/playbooks#regional-failover) to surface repeated failovers per region. - Canary rollout to dedicated and hosted regions for 1 hour, then gradual rollout. - Rollback plan: flip feature flag slo_enforcer_shared_backoff=false and redeploy. Related: ENG-4218 (root cause investigation), SUP-1123 (customer incident report).

release_notes: Hotfix: prevent regional failover thrashing by ensuring shared backoff/hysteresis state across decision paths; adds jitter and thrash-cap. Configurable via deploy flags.
notes_for_oncall: If customers report repeated region flips after rollout, flip slo_enforcer_shared_backoff=false and redeploy slo-enforcer. If thrash-cap fires frequently, check slo_enforcer.backoff_applied and region_failover.count events in the last 10m.
